rules: Never attach an external artist identifier from name similarity alone.
Require corroborating release, label, geography, membership, or relationship evidence.
Store release and release-group identifiers separately.
Preserve source-specific identifiers without treating an external database as canonical authority.
Record rejected ambiguous matches when they are likely to recur.
Cross-source agreement may raise qualification of the specific fact corroborated, not the entire entity.
discogs_note: Discogs PAN/ANV conventions are useful for reconciliation but remain source-specific; Haamu preserves its own canonical identity model.
